say:3:1011504001:0.text: I thought I could get Master Eomir to change his mind...

say:4:1011504002:0.text: I thought he would at least care about the future of our forest...

say:5:1011504003:0.text: Parisa, it's not your fault. Master Eomir's reaction took everyone by surprise.

say:14:1011504009:0.text: Even we had to go through so much trouble to bypass the Thorned Guards, but she just popped up outta nowhere on top of that tent...

say:15:1011504010:0.text: I know, right?! If we weren't so busy running for our lives, I'd stop and applaud her!
